name: CountUp-TS-TW
blurb: Animates numbers from one value to another with formatting and lifecycle callbacks.
description: Number counter that smoothly animates between values using spring physics. Supports decimal formatting, separators, and triggers on InView. Configurable delay, duration, and callbacks.
use_when: Displaying stats, metrics, or counters that need visual emphasis through animation.
avoid_when: When animation is disabled in accessibility preferences or in performance-critical contexts.
a11y: InView-triggered animation respects viewport. Text content updates for screen readers. Consider prefers-reduced-motion in usage.
